name: [SOUL REAPER] Anime Final Quest
desc:
🛠️ [Full Release]
The game is still under heavy development, new content, balance changes and features are constantly being added. Encounter a bug? Have an idea? Join our community and help shape the future of the game!

❓[How to Begin Your Adventure]
- Fight through Anime Dungeons
- Obtain Weapons & Gears
- Collect drops & Craft Cosmetics
- Challenge Dungeon Bosses
- Gather Runes to enhance your build
- Complete Quests to earn exclusive rewards

🖥️ Controls:
- M1 - LMB / Button X / Square / R2 / RT
- Skill 1 - 1 / L1 / LB
- Skill 2 - 2 / L2 / LT
- Skill 3 - 3 / R1 / RB
- Gear - 4 / Button Y / Triangle
- Ultimate Skill - 5 / DPad Left
- Dash - Q / Button B / Circle
- Awakening - G / DPad Up
- Lock Camera - Mouse Wheel / L3
- Shiftlock - Ctrl / Dpad Down
